name: Easy TikTok Feed – TikTok Video, Feed & Gallery Plugin
author: maltathemes

sections.description:
⭐ TikTok Feed is now part of Easy Social Feed — with more features

We’ve moved TikTok Feed into our main plugin, Easy Social Feed, so you get a better TikTok experience plus ongoing updates in one place.

Why switch?
* More TikTok Feed features than this standalone plugin
* One plugin for TikTok — and Instagram, Facebook, YouTube & X if you need them later
* Only want TikTok? Turn off every other module. Disabled modules don’t load — so your site stays fast

👉 Install Easy Social Feed (free) → enable the TikTok module → connect your account and you’re done.
After that, you can safely deactivate this plugin.

Easy TikTok Feed is the easiest way to display beautiful TikTok video feeds on your WordPress site — no API tokens or manual setup required.

Perfect for influencers, creators, brands, and marketers looking to increase visibility, drive traffic, and grow followers.

Use this plugin to showcase your latest videos, promote your content, or even monetize traffic via AdSense, affiliate links, or campaigns.

✅ Free Features

  • Fast & Lightweight – No bloat, no slowdowns
  • Mobile Responsive – Feeds look great on all devices
  • Clean Grid Layout – Minimal layout for embedding your feed
  • Basic Custom Styling – Adjust spacing, colors, and dimensions
  • One-Click TikTok Connect – No tokens or API keys needed
  • Built-In Caching – Reduces API calls and speeds up load time

🚀 Upgrade to Pro

Get access to advanced layouts, filtering, and multi-account support:

  • 🧱 More Layouts – Masonry, Carousel, and List
  • 🔁 Multiple TikTok Accounts – Connect and display multiple profiles
  • 🖼️ Advanced Popup Viewer – Lightbox-style popups with autoplay
  • 🔍 Advanced Filters – Filter by keyword, length, etc.
  • 🎯 Hashtag Feeds – Show videos by TikTok hashtag (coming soon)
  • 💬 Priority Support – Fast support from the core development team

👉 Upgrade to Pro directly from your WordPress dashboard:
TikTok Feed → Upgrade

Shortcode Examples

Basic Grid Feed (Free)
`[easy_tiktok_feed]“`

[Pro] Carousel Layout with Autoplay
`[easy_tiktok_feed layout=”carousel” autoplay=”true”]“`
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/easy-tiktok-feed or install it via Plugins > Add New
  2. Activate through the ‘Plugins’ screen
  3. Go to TikTok Feeds → Connect Account to authorize
  4. Use the shortcode [easy_tiktok_feed] to show the feed anywhere
sections.faq:
Should I switch to Easy Social Feed?

Yes — TikTok Feed now lives in Easy Social Feed with more features and active development. Install it, enable only the TikTok module if that’s all you need, then deactivate this plugin. Unused modules stay disabled and don’t affect site speed.

Do I need a TikTok API key?

No — simply click “Connect” inside the plugin to authorize your TikTok account.

Can I use layouts like Carousel or Masonry?

Yes, but only in the Pro version.

Can I show feeds from any TikTok username?

Due to TikTok API limitations, only connected (authenticated) accounts are supported.

Can I connect more than one account?

Yes — with the Pro version, you can display multiple TikTok profiles.

How do I upgrade to Pro?

After activating the plugin, go to TikTok Feed → Upgrade from your WordPress dashboard.
